None. Screen capture only, no person anywhere.

Below it, large dark algebraic working in the same hand runs down the left with fractions, a square-root sign and two boxed numeric answers, underlined by a blue scribble. On the yellow pane at the right, more handwriting in the same black hand: a circumference equals pi times d over two formula, a numeric substitution, a semi-circumference line and two boxed perimeter results. [Mood]
Cool near-white UI with a warm cream note pane and small saturated accent dots. Clinical and workmanlike, unmistakably a screen share, with the huge handwritten equations on white and yellow the strongest read at thumbnail size.
